label: prop:q-beta-radius-of-convergence-gate
title: $\mathfrak{Q}_\beta$ precision-ladder $\S 4(a)$ formalize-first gate — the log-correction generating function $g(u) = \sum_{k \ge 2} c_k u^k$ must have a simple pole at $u_{\text{substrate}}$, and any candidate $F(q)$ whose nearest singularity lies elsewhere is structurally REFUTED
html:
Proposition. \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder \S 4(a) formalize-first gate — the log-correction generating function g(u) = \sum_{k \ge 2} c_k u^k must have a simple pole at u_{\text{substrate}}, and any candidate F(q) whose nearest singularity lies elsewhere is structurally REFUTED

In the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta precision-ladder factorisation, the log-correction generating function g(u) := \sum c_k u^k has a simple pole at u = u_{\text{substrate}} \approx 0.00852. Any candidate Habiro element F(q) whose generating function has its nearest singularity elsewhere is structurally REFUTED.

This provides the anchor-stable formalize-first gate. The simple-pole location is anchor-stable. A candidate is rejected if the ratio |u_0 - u_{\text{substrate}}| / u_{\text{substrate}} exceeds 10^{-6}.
